mechanism_narrative: The FEDFUNDS rate is always negatively related to S&P 500 returns because a higher rate compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to lower valuations and negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not significantly negative (p>0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 295 signals persistent inflation, which leads to expectations of monetary tightening and thus negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 295, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE (above 0.2pp in 3 months) and fall in INDPRO (below 1.0% in 3 months) signals an imminent recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 is expected to have negative returns because the Fed is raising rates to combat inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST is above 1400, it signals a strong housing market which supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1400, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO is below 100, it signals a contraction in manufacturing, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 4.0% signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The RSAFS level is positively related to S&P 500 returns because a higher level of retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between RSAFS and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not significantly positive (p>0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.
